title: Playing hard like an ox and Percy Humphrey's laziness on the bandstand
summary: Guesnon says he cannot take it easy when he plays, and he and Rolf mock how Percy Humphrey passes solos to everyone else.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: Oh, no, I'm better than I've never been in my life, you see, because I'm more mature. I'm a little tired. I just know, you see. Yeah. And another thing about me, you see, I cannot play my banjo as an old man should. No. That's another thing about me. I say I'm going to go out there and I'm not going to, I'm going to take it easy. But there is no such a thing. You got some musicians can't take it easy. Another one like me was Papa John. That's why he fell dead on the music. Yeah. See, as an old man, 89 years old, he should have been picking these days too. Yeah. Yeah. But the music get good. Yeah, yeah, yeah. And he's going down and, you know, he's waiting on by the bridge and he's going, huh, huh, huh, huh. Yeah. You see what I mean? Can't play like an old man should. Well, they got some people just can't do it and I happen to be one of them. When I go out, I wait. You see, that's one thing about me, another thing why they want me in preference to everybody else. You see, she gave me the name of the ox. She gave me that nickname. For you strong. Yeah, for, yeah, for where I wait. That's right. I work like an ox. I guarantee. I work. I strictly work.
